bed.note: Behind the standing character, long axis along X; near edge y 0.20 (35 mm behind the rearmost calf point 0.165); covers the lying body x -0.92..0.85.

sword_bed_socket.description: sword lying flat on the bed top right of the seated hip, blade towards -X (tip 0.335 m past the bed end, centre of mass over the bed)

why_this_socket: arm reach is short: upper arm 0.215 m + forearm 0.236 m, wrist at most 0.444 m from the shoulder (seated-lean-scan.json)
standing: blade-down holds are out of reach; only Idle-like (16.5 deg) or outward (34.4 deg) holds near the hip (socket-scan/scan.json)
seated upright: no bed-top grip right of the hip is reachable (seated-scan.json, 0 of 54)
supine beside the hand: least wrist bend 61 deg with the sword touching the body (supine-scan.json)
seated with spine_02 15 deg right lean and clavicle.R 10 deg down: grip (-0.40, 0.32) reachable at 95% of the arm, wrist bend 37.9 deg, 18 mm from the coat (seated-lean-scan.json)
consequences: LieDown: sit, lean right and lay the sword down (put_sword_down), then lie back with the head towards +X while the legs swing high over the sword to the -X half
GetUp: sit up with the legs swinging back over the sword, lean right and pick the sword up (pick_sword_up), stand to Idle
Sleep_Loop: sword on the bed socket for the whole loop; no grasp

other_assumptions.bed_support_window: one establishment frame for all five support sets (stricter reading of r6 line 132)
other_assumptions.socket_pop: 1 mm / 1 degree at each switch (equal to the loop-seam limits; r6 states only 'no per-frame weapon drift')
other_assumptions.transitions: for P4: neighbouring clips in a chain share the socket at their joined ends; blends happen only at clip ends
other_assumptions.stance_windows: LieDown/GetUp declare stance windows where the feet are planted (standing, seated), so touchdown/lift-off are refined to quarter frames
other_assumptions.head_extension: no pillow in the request's bed proxy: lying flat needs about 19 deg neck+head extension (posture-01); a pillow would need a new request version (r6 line 255)
other_assumptions.bed_proxy_in_delivery: r6 lists bed-proxy as a part (pivot at the bed centre, outside the character triangle budget); the delivery GLB will carry it as a separate node
